body:
Designer authoring (this issue's scope) shipped in objectui — all four authoring gaps done and merged:

- objectstack-ai/objectui#1954 — `revise` branch picker + back-edge authoring (dashed return arc, excluded from auto-layout) + client-side DAG-modulo-back-edges validation + one-click "add revision loop"
- objectstack-ai/objectui#1955 — the Debug simulator now *walks* the loop (approval suspends; approve/reject/revise decision buttons)
- objectstack-ai/objectui#1958 — un-declared cycles surfaced **inline on the canvas** (red edges/nodes + error banner)

Remaining **AI Build-mode** awareness is tracked in #2274, whose compile-time guardrail slice shipped in #2279. Closing — the flow-designer authoring scope is complete.
